svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.10.3 Spacing and Joints
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING

g.text: Spaced shakes, joints clear of the joints in adjacent courses, (1)
Gaps shown dark, drawn 8 mm wide

svg.text: Shakes are spaced 6 mm to 9 mm (¼″ to ⅜″)
apart and the joints in any one course are
separated not less than 40 mm (1 9/16″) from
Drawn: shakes 100 to 350 mm wide, 450 mm long at a 190 mm exposure. The plan is cut at the top. Widths and joint positions are illustration only.
